summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to allow individuals to use health savings accounts, Archer medical savings accounts, health flexible spending arrangements, and health reimbursement arrangements to purchase certain wearable devices, up to $375 per year, starting in 2026.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to allow certain wearable devices to be purchased using health savings accounts and other spending arrangements. This effectively expands the definition of qualified medical expenses, which can lead to a slight reduction in taxable income for individuals utilizing these accounts, thus representing a minor tax cut.

The bill expands tax-advantaged treatment of certain wearable devices under HSAs, Archer MSAs, and FSAs/HRA, allowing up to $375 per year to be spent tax-free; this constitutes a new tax expenditure that reduces federal revenue and therefore increases the deficit.
